(defn- canonical-normal?
  [schema]
  (and
   (map? schema)
   (let [kind (:kind schema)]
     (cond
       (= kind :primitive)
       (and (has? schema :name)
            (keyword? (:name schema)))

       (= kind :reference)
       (and (has? schema :name)
            (symbol? (:name schema)))

       (= kind :union)
       (and (vector? (:types schema))
            (every? canonical-normal? (:types schema)))

       (= kind :vector)
       (canonical-normal? (:item schema))

       (= kind :tuple)
       (and (vector? (:items schema))
            (every? canonical-normal? (:items schema)))

       (= kind :map)
       (and
        (vector? (:fields schema))
        (every?
         (fn [field]
           (and (map? field)
                (has? field :name)
                (canonical-normal? (:type field))))
         (:fields schema)))

       (= kind :fn)
       (let [inputs (:inputs schema)]
         (and
          (map? inputs)
          (vector? (:fixed inputs))
          (every? canonical-normal? (:fixed inputs))
          (or (nil? (:rest inputs))
              (canonical-normal? (:rest inputs)))
          (canonical-normal? (:output schema))))

       (= kind :function)
       (and (vector? (:arities schema))
            (every?
             (fn [arity]
               (and (= :fn (:kind arity))
                    (canonical-normal? arity)))
             (:arities schema)))

       (= kind :enum)
       (vector? (:values schema))

       (= kind :extension)
       (and (keyword? (:head schema))
            (vector? (:arguments schema))
            (has? schema :surface))

       (= kind :unknown)
       (has? schema :surface)

       :else false))))

(defn- normalize-normalized [schema]
  (if (canonical-normal? schema)
    schema
    (let [kind (:kind schema)
          children (get schema :children [])]
      (cond
        (= kind :primitive)
        (normalize
         (if (has? schema :name)
           (:name schema)
           (first children)))

        (= kind :reference)
        {:kind :reference
         :name (if (has? schema :name)
                 (:name schema)
                 (first children))}

        (or (= kind :union) (= kind :or))
        (normalize-union
         (if (has? schema :types)
           (:types schema)
           children))

        (= kind :vector)
        {:kind :vector
         :item (normalize
                (if (has? schema :item)
                  (:item schema)
                  (first children)))}

        (= kind :tuple)
        {:kind :tuple
         :items (vec
                 (map normalize
                      (if (has? schema :items)
                        (:items schema)
                        children)))}

        (= kind :map)
        {:kind :map
         :fields
         (vec
          (map normalize-field
               (if (has? schema :fields)
                 (:fields schema)
                 children)))}

        (= kind :fn)
        (normalize-fn-map schema)

        (= kind :function)
        (normalize-function-arities
         (if (has? schema :arities)
           (:arities schema)
           children))

        (= kind :enum)
        {:kind :enum
         :values (vec
                  (if (has? schema :values)
                    (:values schema)
                    children))}

        (= kind :extension)
        (let [head (if (has? schema :head)
                     (:head schema)
                     (:name schema))
              arguments (if (has? schema :arguments)
                          (:arguments schema)
                          children)]
          {:kind :extension
           :head head
           :arguments (vec arguments)
           :surface (if (has? schema :surface)
                      (:surface schema)
                      (vec (concat [head] arguments)))})

        (= kind :unknown)
        {:kind :unknown
         :surface (if (has? schema :surface)
                    (:surface schema)
                    (first children))}

        :else schema))))
